raw_payload.what_happens: The dog darts into the dense forest, nose to the ground, following the faint scent left by the thieves. He bursts into a hidden clearing where a shallow pit glints with stolen treasure. The Sheth, following behind, watches in awe as the dog paws at the pit, revealing the loot.
